name: Project Halo
author: nyannoying
description: The 2026 F1 world feed's onboard halo graphic in place of the 2026 dial, drawn by the game's own HUD: move and resize it in HUD customisation. Read from the running game itself: no UDP telemetry, no companion app.

options.label: Driver names
options.description: Your position and name, and the car one place ahead in the session's classification (the car in P2 when you lead), on the left wing. Practice, qualifying and races; not in Time Trial.

options.label: Turn numbers
options.description: The next turn's number and direction, from 220 m before it.

options.label: Validation log
options.description: Off by default. Writes what the halo reads from the game, 30 times a second, as CSV to %LOCALAPPDATA%\nick.f1-2026-halo\diag (up to 64 MB per launch). Turn on only to send a log.
